items.title: 60322_John Bubbles oral history interview
items.q: they can get me cheaper than them other actors such as Harry Belafonte, Sidney Poitier and Sammy Davis, Jr., and Lena Horne.

ctx.x: I recall reading in Jazz Dance, Marshall Sterns book about you receiving $1750.00 a week in vaudeville.

Yeah, that ain't no money. That ain't no money, though. You're talking about money. That ain't no money. $1750? How do you think Frank Sinatra's rich? He ain't (inaudible) sing as much as I have. I've been in the business before he was born. So what are you going to do about that? What do you do about Sammy Davis? Look at the money that Sammy Davis is making now, we're not trying

to take away from his ability, we're taking him from the time he's doing his act, the time he goes on the stage, the time he goes off four times as much money as I made. That's why I'm in California, that's why I was out here. Because New York wasn't paying no money comparing when you come out here you get five thousand and ten thousand dollars a week for what they do and I'm doing four times as much in New York for quarter, I might as well come out here where they can get me cheaper than them other actors such…
